What it does

CompanyCam solves the dispute problem: when a customer questions what was done, timestamped and location-stamped photos end the argument. Crew members take photos on their phones and they land in the correct job automatically, tagged and searchable. The value depends entirely on the crew actually taking the photos, so adoption matters more than features.

Where the AI actually is

Automatically tags, sorts and searches photos by project and content.

Pros

  • Settles disputes with timestamped photo records
  • Crew photos go straight into the right job
  • Useful for insurance and warranty claims

Cons

  • Requires the crew to actually take the photos

Who it suits

Built with Roofers, Remodelers & carpenters, General contractors, Plumbers in mind. Any trade that needs proof of what was done and when.
